panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 3 panels (A, B, C). A: Sagittal T2-weighted MRI from a 60-year-old woman with N2O-unrelated subacute combined degeneration shows a longitudinally extensive cervical-to-thoracic cord T2 hyperintensity, a characteristic SCD manifestation. B: Axial T2-weighted MRI from a 23-year-old man with N2O-related subacute combined degeneration demonstrates the classic inverted V sign of dorsal column involvement. A: Sagittal T2-weighted MRI of the cervical spine in a patient with primary vitamin B12 deficiency (vitamin B12-SCD group) showing a short-segment cervical cord T2 hyperintensity, a classic manifestation of subacute combined degeneration of the spinal cord; the figure and in-text text explicitly attribute this panel to SCD. panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 3 panels (A, B, C). A: Sagittal T1-weighted MRI of the cervical spine in a patient with subacute combined degeneration, showing hypointensity involving the posterior and lateral columns (arrow), as stated in the caption ('T1-weighted MRI scans showing the dorsal spinal cord with hypointensity involving the posterior and lateral columns before treatment'). This is a real patient image with a specific SCD manifestation; the T1 hypointensity is not covered by the allowed vocabulary, hence proposed. B: Sagittal T2-weighted MRI showing longitudinally extensive hyperintensity of the dorsal and lateral cervical cord (arrows) in a patient with subacute combined degeneration, matching the captioned and in-text description of the classic cord signal change. C: Axial T2-weighted MRI at C3 showing the bilateral symmetric dorsal column hyperintensity ('inverted V sign', arrows) that is the textbook manifestation of subacute combined degeneration.

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 3 panels (A, B, C). A: Sagittal T2-weighted MRI of the thoracic spinal cord in a patient with subacute combined degeneration, showing the characteristic high-signal cord lesions marked by arrows. B: Axial T2-weighted MRI at T5 in a patient with subacute combined degeneration, showing the axial cord “small print” sign corresponding to dorsal column involvement. C: Axial T2-weighted MRI at T10-T12 in a patient with subacute combined degeneration, showing the axial cord “small print” sign corresponding to dorsal column involvement.

in_text_mentions: Thoracic vertebral MRI showed long T1 and T2 signals in both dorsal and lateral columns of T5-T6, i.e., the “small character” sign (Figure 4). Electromyography showed substantially decreased amplitude and conduction velocity of the tested sensory and motor nerves, multiple peripheral nerve injuries, motor and sensory nerve axonal damage, and myelin injures. Thyroid tests showed the following: free thyronine, 4.0 pM (NR 3.1-6.8 pM); free thyroxine, 11.24 pM (NR 12-22 pM); thyroid-stimulating hormone, 5.97 μIU/mL (NR 0.27-4.2 μIU/mL), and thyroid peroxidase antibody, 93.96 IU/mL (NR 0-34 IU/mL).
